mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals severe labor market distress, triggering fiscal stimulus that lifts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signals deepening economic contraction, prompting aggressive stimulus that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and GDPC1 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is negative in regression.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, industrial production below 100.5 signals manufacturing weakness, preceding market correction and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO falls below 100.5.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price inflation exceeding 259.0 triggers Fed tightening expectations, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 259.0.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly payroll growth above 0.5% signals strengthening labor market, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth rate exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During post-pandemic recovery, retail sales below 530,000 million dollars signals weak consumer spending, triggering stimulus that lifts equity markets and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during post-pandemic recovery when RSAFS falls below 530,000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction, preceding market downturn and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0.
